entry_exit_clock.exit: close of bar B (S+1h), fill price = last_price of bar B; no stop, no early exit; position is open at the S snapshot and books the transfer [proposal_A5_P1.json entry_exit_fills.exit; measure.py anchor entry=-2, exit=0 lines 534-537]
